gir_rules.description: GIR (General Rules for the Interpretation of the HS) - Tariff Classification Rules

section_01.name: Live animals; animal products
section_01.description: Live animals (mammals, birds, insects, fish), edible meat and offal, fish and other aquatic products, dairy products (milk, cheese, butter, yogurt), eggs, honey, and other edible products of animal origin not elsewhere specified.

section_02.name: Vegetable products
section_02.description: Live plants, trees, bulbs, roots, cut flowers; fresh vegetables and edible plants; edible fruits, nuts, and seeds; cereals (rice, wheat, maize, oats, barley); coffee, tea, mate, and spices; oil seeds and oleaginous fruits; vegetable gums, resins, lac; and vegetable fibers and plaiting materials such as cotton, flax, hemp, jute, sisal, and kapok.

section_03.name: Animal or vegetable fats and oils
section_03.description: Animal fats (beef tallow, lard, fish oil, whale oil), vegetable oils (palm, coconut, olive, sunflower, soybean, canola, groundnut), refined and crude oils, margarine, shortening, butter and ghee, fatty acids, waxes (beeswax, carnauba, paraffin), oil cakes and meals from oil-bearing fruits and seeds

section_04.name: Prepared foodstuffs, beverages, vinegar
section_04.description: Prepared and processed foods including breads, cereals, pasta, noodles; biscuits, cakes, pastries; jams, jellies, preserves, marmalades; sauces, condiments, seasonings, spice mixes; sugar, molasses, honey, sugar syrups; chocolate and cocoa preparations; soups, broths, prepared meals; canned, frozen, and dried foods; baby foods; dietary and health foods; vinegar and acetic acid; beverages including coffee, tea, cocoa drinks, soft drinks, juices, beer, wine, spirits

section_05.name: Mineral products
section_05.description: Natural mineral products including salt (common salt, sea salt); sand, gravel, aggregates; natural stone (granite, marble, limestone, slate, sandstone, pumice); cement and cement clinker; gypsum and anhydrite; chalk, phosphates, and potassium salts; coal (steam coal, coking coal, coal dust); coke; peat; crude petroleum; petroleum products (gasoline, diesel, kerosene, fuel oil, lubricating oil); natural gas; bituminous materials and asphalt; other minerals and ores; mineral substances for industrial use (sulfur, feldspar, kaolin)

section_06.name: Products of the chemical or allied industries
section_06.description: Inorganic chemicals including acids (sulfuric, hydrochloric, phosphoric, nitric), bases (ammonia, sodium hydroxide, potassium hydroxide); salts and metal oxides; chlorine and alkaline chlorides; sulfites and sulfates; phosphates and phosphorous compounds; organic chemicals including hydrocarbons, alcohols, aldehydes, carboxylic acids, esters; nitrogen-containing compounds; pharmaceutical active ingredients, vitamins, hormones, antibiotics, vaccines; pesticides, herbicides, insecticides, fungicides; dyes, pigments, and colorants; paints, varnishes, lacquers, and coatings; adhesives, glues, and sealants; cosmetics and toiletries; soaps, detergents, and cleaning agents; disinfectants and sterilizing agents; plastic resins and synthetic rubber; essential oils and perfume compounds

section_07.name: Plastics, rubber; articles thereof
section_07.description: Plastic materials including polyethylene (LDPE, HDPE, LLDPE), polypropylene, polyvinyl chloride (PVC), polyurethane, polyester, acrylic resins, nylon, polystyrene, and other polymers; plastic products including sheets, films, tubes, pipes, containers, bags, bottles, boxes, automotive parts, furniture, toys, and miscellaneous articles; natural rubber and synthetic rubber (synthetic rubbers including SBR, NBR, neoprene, silicone rubber); rubber products including latex, rubber sheets, tubes, hoses, gaskets, seals, tires, mats, belts, and other vulcanized or hardened rubber goods

section_08.name: Raw hides and skins, leather, furskins
section_08.description: Raw hides and skins (bovine, equine, porcine, ovine, caprine, and other animals); wet-blue leather, vegetable-tanned leather, chrome-tanned leather, and other tanned leather; leather articles including footwear, belts, bags, wallets, jackets, garments, upholstery, and furniture; furskins and furry animal skins (mink, fox, rabbit, beaver, seal, otter); fur clothing and fur-trimmed garments; leather dust, scraps, and leather fiber; parchment and vellum; gut and catgut

section_09.name: Wood and articles of wood, wood charcoal
section_09.description: Wood and wood products including logs, timber, sawn wood, lumber, veneer, plywood, particle board, fiberboard (MDF), and hardboard; wooden articles including furniture, doors, windows, frames, boxes, crates, pallets, tool handles, and decorative items; wood charcoal and activated charcoal; wood pulp (mechanical and chemical); paper and paperboard products including newsprint, printing paper, tissue paper, kraft paper, cardboard, corrugated cardboard, and waxed paper; waste paper and paper for recycling

section_10.name: Pulp, paper and paperboard; articles thereof
section_10.description: Pulp including wood pulp (chemical pulp, mechanical pulp, semi-chemical pulp), waste paper pulp, and pulp sheets; paper products including newsprint, printing and writing paper, tissue paper (toilet paper, facial tissue), kraft paper, wrapping paper, specialty papers, and coated/laminated papers; cardboard and paperboard products including corrugated cardboard, cartons, boxes, tubes, and rigid paperboard; paper articles including envelopes, bags, labels, and packaging materials; printed matter including books, magazines, newspapers, brochures, and posters; waste paper and recovered paper for recycling

section_11.name: Textiles and textile articles
section_11.description: Textile fibers including natural fibers (cotton, wool, silk, linen, hemp, jute) and synthetic fibers (polyester, nylon, acrylic, elastane, polypropylene); yarn and thread of all materials; fabrics including woven fabrics, knitted fabrics, nonwoven fabrics, felt, and lace; textile blends and composite fabrics; carpet, rugs, and floor coverings; rope, twine, and cordage; textile articles including clothing and apparel (shirts, dresses, pants, jackets, coats, undergarments, hosiery, gloves, scarves, sweaters); home textiles (bedding, blankets, sheets, pillows, pillowcases, curtains, table linens, kitchen textiles, towels); upholstered items; textile waste and scraps

section_12.name: Footwear, headgear; articles of plaiting material
section_12.description: Footwear including shoes, boots, sandals, slippers, athletic shoes, sports shoes, dress shoes, work shoes, safety shoes, and informal footwear; shoe components (soles, heels, insoles, uppers, straps, buckles); shoe parts for assembly; headgear including hats, caps, helmets, turbans, hoods, berets, beanies, and other head coverings; articles of plaiting material including baskets, mats, place mats, coasters made from plaited natural materials (straw, palm leaf, rattan); wickerwork; netting and mesh products; articles made from natural plaiting materials

section_13.name: Articles of stone, plaster, cement, asbestos, etc.
section_13.description: Articles of stone including granite, marble, slate, limestone, and sandstone articles (tiles, blocks, slabs, paving stones, architectural elements, monuments); ceramic and pottery products including porcelain, earthenware, and stoneware; ceramic tiles for flooring and walls; ceramic tableware (plates, cups, bowls, saucers, teapots); ceramic sanitary ware (toilets, basins, bathtubs); bricks and roofing tiles; glass products including glass sheets, glass plates, tempered glass, laminated glass, float glass, mirror glass; glass containers (bottles, jars); glass tableware (drinking glasses, wine glasses, tumblers, dishes); glass decorative items; glass fiber and glass wool; asbestos and asbestos products (asbestos cement, insulation materials); lime and lime products (calcium oxide, slaked lime, hydrated lime); plaster and plaster products (gypsum plaster, plaster of paris); cement and cement articles; concrete products; refractory materials

section_14.name: Pearls, precious stones, metals and articles thereof
section_14.description: Pearls including natural pearls, cultured pearls, and pearl articles; precious stones and semi-precious stones including diamonds (rough, cut, polished), rubies, sapphires, emeralds, aquamarine, topaz, garnet, amethyst, jade, opal, turquoise, and other gemstones; rough, cut, and polished gemstone articles; precious metals including gold (nuggets, bars, coins, bullion dust), silver (bars, coins, bullion), platinum group metals (platinum, palladium, iridium, rhodium); precious metal alloys and compounds; precious metal jewelry (necklaces, bracelets, rings, earrings, brooches, pendants, chains); watches and watch cases; precious metal objects (decorative items, cutlery, tableware); dental and medical precious metal alloys

section_15.name: Base metals and articles of base metal
section_15.description: Iron and iron products including iron ore, iron powder, wrought iron; steel and steel products including carbon steel, stainless steel, alloy steel, steel bars, steel sheets, steel plates, steel coils, steel tubes, steel pipes, steel wire, steel wire rope, steel structural shapes; aluminum and aluminum products including aluminum ingots, sheets, foil, wire, powder, profiles, and structural shapes; copper and copper products including copper cathodes, sheets, rods, tubes, wires, and copper alloys (brass, bronze); zinc and zinc products including zinc ingots, sheets, powder; tin and tin products; lead and lead products; nickel and nickel products; magnesium, titanium, tungsten, molybdenum, cobalt, vanadium, chromium, and other base metals and alloys; metal fasteners (bolts, screws, nuts, rivets, nails, hooks); chains and springs; metal containers, tanks, drums, and buckets; metal tools and hand tools; metal kitchen utensils and tableware; metal furniture and furniture parts; metal frameworks, gratings, and meshes; metal strapping and packaging materials; metal waste and scrap

section_16.name: Machinery and mechanical appliances; electrical equipment
section_16.description: Machinery and mechanical appliances including engines (diesel, petrol, gas turbines), motors (electric motors, stepper motors), generators, turbines, pumps, compressors, fans, blowers, heat exchangers, boilers, pressure vessels, industrial machinery parts; food processing and beverage machinery; textile, printing, packaging, and material handling machinery; pumps and hydraulic equipment; pneumatic tools and equipment; bearings, gears, valves, couplings, and transmission equipment; electrical equipment and apparatus including electric motors, generators, transformers, switchgear, electrical cables, wires, connectors, circuit breakers, fuses, relays, control panels, distribution boards; lighting fixtures and electrical bulbs; electrical heating and cooling equipment; information technology equipment (computers, laptops, servers, tablets, peripherals); electronic components and semiconductors (microchips, processors, memory modules, hard drives, SSDs, motherboards, circuit boards); electronic devices and appliances (air conditioners, refrigerators, washing machines, dishwashers, microwave ovens, televisions, stereos, radios); consumer electronics (cameras, video recorders, audio equipment, mobile devices, game consoles)

section_17.name: Vehicles, aircraft, vessels and transport equipment
section_17.description: Road vehicles including motorcycles, three-wheelers, automobiles (sedans, SUVs, wagons, coupes), trucks (light, medium, heavy duty), buses (intercity, city buses), commercial vehicles (vans, pickups, delivery trucks, tractor units), tractors; vehicle components and parts (engines, transmissions, chassis, bodies, wheels, tires, brakes, suspensions, steering systems, electrical systems, airbags, seats, dashboards, glass, mirrors, lighting, interior trim); aircraft including airplanes (commercial, cargo, private), helicopters, jets, gliders, drones; aircraft engines and parts (turbines, compressors, avionics systems, instruments, interior components); vessels and ships including cargo ships, tankers, fishing vessels, cruise ships, container ships, bulk carriers, tugboats, yachts, speedboats, houseboats, lifeboats; ship equipment and parts (marine engines, propellers, anchors, navigation instruments, communication equipment, safety equipment); railway equipment including locomotives (diesel, electric), passenger trains, freight trains, trams, metro trains, rail cars; railway track and infrastructure; signaling and safety equipment; specialized transport equipment

section_18.name: Optical, photographic, precision, medical instruments, etc.
section_18.description: Optical instruments including telescopes, microscopes, binoculars, magnifying glasses; optical elements (lenses, prisms, mirrors, filters, optical glass); photographic equipment including cameras (film cameras, digital cameras, video cameras, instant cameras), lenses, flash units, tripods, light meters; photographic materials (film, photographic paper); measuring and precision instruments including thermometers, barometers, hygrometers, manometers, scales, balances, gauges; surveying and leveling instruments (transits, levels, theodolites, rangefinders); medical and surgical instruments including surgical tools (scalpels, forceps, scissors), needles, syringes, lancets; medical diagnostic devices (x-ray machines, ultrasound equipment, MRI machines, CT scanners, echocardiography equipment); monitoring devices (blood pressure meters, thermometers, glucose meters, pulse oximeters, stethoscopes); dental equipment and instruments; prosthetic devices and mobility aids (wheelchairs, crutches, canes, walkers); hearing aids and pacemakers; therapeutic equipment; clocks and watches (mechanical, electronic, quartz); timepieces and timing instruments (timers, stopwatches, chronometers); musical instruments including string instruments (guitars, violins, pianos), woodwind instruments (flutes, clarinet, saxophone), brass instruments (trumpets, horns, tubas), percussion instruments (drums, cymbals, timpani), electronic musical instruments (synthesizers, keyboards); music boxes and other sound-producing items

section_19.name: Arms and ammunition; miscellaneous articles
section_19.description: Weapons and arms including firearms (rifles, pistols, shotguns, revolvers, submachine guns, assault rifles, sporting firearms), air guns, crossbows, bows and arrows, swords, knives, bayonets, spears, clubs, axes, and traditional weapons; military weapons including artillery, cannons, landmines, torpedoes, bombs, rockets, and missiles; ammunition including bullets, cartridges, shells, powder charges; explosives and related materials (gunpowder, primers, fuses, detonators); sporting and hunting equipment including firearms and ammunition; miscellaneous articles including antiques and collectibles, art objects (sculptures, paintings, prints), rare books and manuscripts, toys and games, dolls, sports equipment (bicycles, skateboards, skiing equipment, golf clubs, tennis rackets, fishing rods), camping and outdoor equipment (tents, backpacks, camping gear), luggage and bags, travel accessories, umbrellas, fans, lighters, buttons, zippers, and other non-textile fasteners, decorative ornaments, souvenirs, and miscellaneous items not classified elsewhere
